Perform a root-cause analysis for: <failure>

Do not edit files unless explicitly asked. Use current source, tests, logs/errors supplied, and repository history/docs as evidence.

Separate:
- trigger/conditions;
- proximate failure;
- actual root cause;
- contributing design/process factors;
- why existing tests/guards did not catch it;
- blast radius and similar paths at risk.

Then propose the smallest corrective fix, regression tests, and optional systemic prevention. Mark evidence vs hypothesis clearly.
